verdict.rationale: The Batch API explicitly supports sending large asynchronous groups of requests at 50% lower cost with a dedicated higher rate-limit pool and 24-hour turnaround, directly enabling bulk operations across many items; rate-limits and pricing docs further clarify how batch scales for high-volume workloads. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of batch usage at scale and detail on per-batch item limits or failure handling.
